memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Now that the Lord your God has given them rest as he promised, return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan. But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you: to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, to keep his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and all your soul." — Josh 22:4-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joshua releases the eastern tribes to go home, but he does not send them off empty. He sends them with a charge — one of the most beautiful summaries of the whole life of faith in the Old Testament. Love the Lord, walk in His ways, keep His commands, hold fast to Him, and serve Him with all your heart and soul.

Notice the order. Everything begins with love. Obedience, faithfulness, and service all flow out of a heart that loves God. This is not cold rule-keeping; it is the response of people who have seen God's goodness and want to cling to Him.

Jesus Himself pointed back to this very command as the greatest of all — to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind and strength (Mark 12:30). The whole law hangs on love.

As these tribes return to ordinary life — to farms, families and daily work — they carry this charge with them. And so do we. When the mountaintop moments pass and we return to the routine, the call remains the same: hold fast to God and serve Him wholeheartedly. The Christian life is not lived only in great victories but in loving God faithfully through ordinary days. Let love for Him be the quiet engine of everything you do.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does your obedience flow out of love for God, or feel like mere duty?
2. What would it look like to "hold fast" to God in your ordinary week?
3. How can you serve God wholeheartedly right where you are?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I want to love You with all my heart and soul. Help me to hold fast to You and serve You faithfully, not just in big moments but in ordinary days. Amen.
